name: AuxPair.adjoint_theta_eq_formLift
summary: The datum of O is an edge, hence an arrow both ways; z and the algebraic form of the lift have the same inner product with every Ξ, by the hypothesis, the expression of θ as a conjugated descent and the adjointness of lift and descent.

steps.claim: Since l fits O, the real datum of O is an edge, so the finite datum Υ of O gives an arrow A from the type of l on W to the type of V and, for the swapped pair, an arrow B back (`AuxPair.FitsParams.isEdge`, `IsEdge.isArrow`). The algebraic form of the lift of y is a member of FormV(O) (its values transform by the level of O, `IsArrow.formRep_formLift`, `AuxPair.pairWeil_fockDatum`). For every Ξ: ⟨z, Ξ⟩ = petersson(W, y, θ(O)(Ξ)) by (a); θ(O)(Ξ) is a multiple of the conjugate of the descent of conj Ξ (`AuxPair.theta_eq_smul_star_lift_swap`); the adjoint of the lift through A is the conjugate of the descent through B (`IsArrow.inner_formLift_adjoint`); and inner products of algebraic forms are multiples of Petersson products (`LevelPlaces.LevelForm.inner_eq_petersson`). So z and that algebraic form have equal inner products with every Ξ, hence are equal.
steps.lean:
(O.fockDatum (highestVector _ O.paramV)) y) := (h.isEdge.isArrow O.a O.b O.auxDatum.2).elim fun A
  B ↦ congrArg _ (ext_inner_right ℂ fun Ξ ↦ by erw [a, LevelForm.inner_eq_petersson (stdSpace ..)
  O.isHCParam_paramV, ofAlgForm_toAlgForm, ← inner_eq_petersson _ ⟨_, isForm_ofAlgForm
  O.isHCParam_paramV Ξ.1⟩, A.inner_formLift_adjoint B rfl (by simp), ← inner_smul_right,
  O.theta_eq_smul_star_lift_swap, mul_comm, ← B.coe_formLift ⟨_, _⟩]; rfl : z = ⟨_, fun k ↦ by
  erw [← toAlgForm_formRep, A.formRep_formLift, ← star_highestVector, O.pairWeil_fockDatum]; simp⟩)
